action_items: Optional UX nit: on web the Notifs/push tab short-circuits to 'Web preview — Push notifications require the mobile app' and the push-test-button does fire /api/push/test (200) but does NOT surface a visible Alert dialog with the response message. On native, the spec wording 'Test push could not be sent' would be shown via Alert.alert — verify on a real device. On web the absence of the alert is acceptable but consider rendering the relay response message inline (e.g. via the existing 'no push tokens' diagnostic) so a clinician sanity-checking from the web build can see what happened.

Tiny test seed cleanup: my pytest run inserts a broadcast row prefixed 'TEST_ Session6 broadcast'. Not auto-deleted (no DELETE /api/broadcasts/<id> path used). Owner can soft-clean from Mongo if needed — non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: push.py:305 — /api/push/test path is clean: branches on services.push_relay.is_configured(); falls back to legacy Expo direct + rich diagnostics block when EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is missing/placeholder. Inline self-heal block before collect_user_tokens correctly defends against orphaned token rows.
push_relay.py:47 — is_configured() reads env on every call, intentionally allowing the relay to flip live without a process restart at deploy time. Good design.
push_relay.py:182 — chunking at 100 recipients/call mirrors the relay's upstream cap; per-chunk idempotency keys carry suffix index. No issues.

/api/broadcasts returns 'broadcast_id' (not 'id') — adjusted test to accept both shapes. Field naming is mildly inconsistent with the rest of the API which uses 'id'; consider standardising but non-blocking.
